# 9. TRAINING RUL

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("CREATING TRAINING RUL")
print("=" * 80)

max_cycle_train = (
    train
    .groupby(
        "engine_id"
    )["cycle"]
    .max()
    .rename(
        "max_cycle"
    )
)

train = train.merge(
    max_cycle_train,
    on="engine_id",
    how="left"
)

train["RUL"] = (
    train["max_cycle"]
    - train["cycle"]
)

train.drop(
    columns=["max_cycle"],
    inplace=True
)

train["RUL"] = train[
    "RUL"
].clip(
    upper=RUL_CAP
)

print(
    "\nTraining RUL created."
)

display(
    train[
        [
            "engine_id",
            "cycle",
            "RUL"
        ]
    ].head(20)
)

# 10. TESTING RUL

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("CREATING TESTING RUL")
print("=" * 80)


max_cycle_test = (
    test
    .groupby(
        "engine_id"
    )["cycle"]
    .max()
    .rename(
        "max_cycle"
    )
)

test = test.merge(
    max_cycle_test,
    on="engine_id",
    how="left"
)


terminal_rul = terminal_rul_file.copy()

terminal_rul["engine_id"] = np.arange(
    1,
    len(terminal_rul) + 1
)


test = test.merge(
    terminal_rul,
    on="engine_id",
    how="left"
)



if test[
    "terminal_RUL"
].isnull().any():

    raise ValueError(
        "Some test engines do not have terminal RUL values."
    )

test["RUL"] = (
    test["max_cycle"]
    + test["terminal_RUL"]
    - test["cycle"]
)

# Apply RUL cap

test["RUL"] = test[
    "RUL"
].clip(
    upper=RUL_CAP
)


test.drop(
    columns=[
        "max_cycle",
        "terminal_RUL"
    ],
    inplace=True
)

print(
    "\nTesting RUL created successfully."
)

display(
    test[
        [
            "engine_id",
            "cycle",
            "RUL"
        ]
    ].head(20)
)

# 18. NASA PHM08 SCORE

def nasa_phm08_score(
    y_true,
    y_pred
):

    y_true = np.asarray(
        y_true
    )

    y_pred = np.asarray(
        y_pred
    )

    errors = (
        y_pred - y_true
    )

    score = 0.0

    for error in errors:

        if error < 0:

            score += (
                np.exp(
                    -error / 13
                ) - 1
            )

        else:

            score += (
                np.exp(
                    error / 10
                ) - 1
            )

    return float(score)
In [122]:
# 19. EVALUATION FUNCTION

def evaluate_model(
    model_name,
    y_true,
    y_pred
):

    mae = mean_absolute_error(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    rmse = np.sqrt(
        mean_squared_error(
            y_true,
            y_pred
        )
    )

    r2 = r2_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    phm08 = nasa_phm08_score(
        y_true,
        y_pred
    )

    return {
        "Model": model_name,
        "MAE": mae,
        "RMSE": rmse,
        "R2": r2,
        "PHM08": phm08
    }

# 23. LSTM SEQUENCE CREATION

def create_sequences(
    data,
    features,
    sequence_length
):

    X = []
    y = []
    metadata = []

    data = data.sort_values(
        [
            "engine_id",
            "cycle"
        ]
    )

    for engine_id, group in data.groupby(
        "engine_id"
    ):

        feature_values = (
            group[
                features
            ]
            .to_numpy(
                dtype=np.float64
            )
        )

        target_values = (
            group[
                "RUL"
            ]
            .to_numpy(
                dtype=np.float64
            )
        )

        cycle_values = (
            group[
                "cycle"
            ]
            .to_numpy()
        )

        if len(
            feature_values
        ) < sequence_length:

            continue

        for end in range(
            sequence_length,
            len(feature_values) + 1
        ):

            start = (
                end
                - sequence_length
            )

            X.append(
                feature_values[
                    start:end
                ]
            )

            y.append(
                target_values[
                    end - 1
                ]
            )

            metadata.append(
                {
                    "engine_id": engine_id,
                    "cycle": cycle_values[
                        end - 1
                    ]
                }
            )

    return (
        np.asarray(
            X,
            dtype=np.float32
        ),
        np.asarray(
            y,
            dtype=np.float32
        ),
        pd.DataFrame(
            metadata
        )
    )

# 25. LSTM MODEL

def build_lstm(
    sequence_length,
    feature_count
):

    model = Sequential(
        [
            Input(
                shape=(
                    sequence_length,
                    feature_count
                )
            ),

            LSTM(
                64,
                return_sequences=True
            ),

            Dropout(
                0.2
            ),

            LSTM(
                32
            ),

            Dropout(
                0.2
            ),

            Dense(
                16,
                activation="relu"
            ),

            Dense(
                1
            )
        ]
    )

    model.compile(
        optimizer="adam",
        loss="mse",
        metrics=["mae"]
    )

    return model

)

history = lstm_model.fit(
    X_train_seq,
    y_train_seq,
    validation_data=(
        X_validation_seq,
        y_validation_seq
    ),
    epochs=LSTM_EPOCHS,
    batch_size=LSTM_BATCH_SIZE,
    callbacks=[
        early_stopping
    ],
    verbose=1
)

print(
    "\nLSTM training completed."
)

print(
    "Epochs completed:",
    len(
        history.history["loss"]
    )
)

# 34. ACTUAL VS PREDICTED FUNCTION

def plot_actual_vs_predicted(
    actual,
    predicted,
    title
):

    actual = np.asarray(
        actual
    )

    predicted = np.asarray(
        predicted
    )

    n = min(
        500,
        len(actual)
    )

    plt.figure(
        figsize=(12, 6)
    )

    plt.plot(
        actual[:n],
        label="Actual RUL"
    )

    plt.plot(
        predicted[:n],
        label="Predicted RUL"
    )

    plt.xlabel(
        "Test Sample"
    )

    plt.ylabel(
        "RUL (Cycles)"
    )

    plt.title(
        title
    )

    plt.legend()

    plt.tight_layout()

    plt.show()

# 37. SEQUENCE-LENGTH ABLATION

print("\n" + "=" * 80)
print("LSTM SEQUENCE-LENGTH ABLATION STUDY")
print("=" * 80)

ablation_results = []

for seq_len in ABLATION_SEQUENCE_LENGTHS:

    print(
        f"\nSequence length: {seq_len}"
    )

    Xtr, ytr, _ = create_sequences(
        training,
        FEATURES,
        seq_len
    )

    Xv, yv, _ = create_sequences(
        validation,
        FEATURES,
        seq_len
    )

    Xte, yte, _ = create_sequences(
        test,
        FEATURES,
        seq_len
    )

    # Apply the SAME scaler fitted on training data

    Xtr = scaler.transform(
        Xtr.reshape(
            -1,
            len(FEATURES)
        )
    ).reshape(
        Xtr.shape
    ).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    Xv = scaler.transform(
        Xv.reshape(
            -1,
            len(FEATURES)
        )
    ).reshape(
        Xv.shape
    ).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    Xte = scaler.transform(
        Xte.reshape(
            -1,
            len(FEATURES)
        )
    ).reshape(
        Xte.shape
    ).astype(
        np.float32
    )

    model = build_lstm(
        seq_len,
        len(FEATURES)
    )

    early_stop = EarlyStopping(
        monitor="val_loss",
        patience=5,
        restore_best_weights=True
    )

    model.fit(
        Xtr,
        ytr,
        validation_data=(
            Xv,
            yv
        ),
        epochs=ABLATION_EPOCHS,
        batch_size=ABLATION_BATCH_SIZE,
        callbacks=[
            early_stop
        ],
        verbose=0
    )

    prediction = model.predict(
        Xte,
        verbose=0
    ).flatten()

    metrics = evaluate_model(
        f"LSTM-{seq_len}",
        yte,
        prediction
    )

    metrics[
        "Sequence_Length"
    ] = seq_len

    ablation_results.append(
        metrics
    )

    print(
        "Completed."
    )

# 42. MAINTENANCE DECISION FUNCTION
def maintenance_decision(
    predicted_rul
):

    if predicted_rul > 60:

        return "Normal Monitoring"

    elif predicted_rul > 30:

        return "Planned Maintenance"

    elif predicted_rul > 10:

        return "Priority Maintenance"

    else:

        return "Immediate Maintenance"
